title: ChatGPT Hit by Widespread Mass Suspensions; Even $200 Pro Subscribers Were Not Spared
excerpt: The AI industry has once again drawn widespread attention recently, as many ChatGPT users have reported in large numbers that their accounts were suddenly deact
content_html:
The AI industry has once again drawn widespread attention recently, as many ChatGPT users have reported in large numbers that their accounts were suddenly deactivated. This even includes a large number of key users who had paid for the expensive $200 Pro subscription, sparking widespread discussion and concern among users.

Sudden Deactivation Comes With No Warning, Huge Amounts of Important Data Instantly Inaccessible

According to feedback from multiple affected users, the account deactivations appeared extremely sudden. Many people had their accounts directly restricted from access without any prior notice or warning.

Because the accounts were suddenly banned, large amounts of core chat histories, daily work materials, and important project documents that users had accumulated on the platform over time could no longer be viewed or exported normally. Some users submitted appeals to the official team immediately after their accounts were banned, but as of now they have not received any response regarding reinstatement.

Official Reason Not Yet Given, Exact Scale of Impact Still to Be Confirmed

In the face of this sudden wave of large-scale account deactivations, as of now OpenAI has not yet issued a unified explanation of the root cause behind the recent concentrated account deactivations, nor has it disclosed the specific number of affected users to the public.

Whether these deactivated accounts actually belong to the same mass ban, and whether there were widespread mistaken bans among them, currently still awaits further verification and an official announcement.
